mission: Identify SAP AI and AI-enabling developer capabilities from official SAP sources, evaluate their accessibility and engineering relevance, validate practical usefulness through controlled hands-on experiments, and share evidence-backed findings to guide informed SAP engineering adoption.
principles: Official documentation is the starting point, not proof.
An executed tool is not automatically useful.
A validated local prototype does not establish SAP tenant behaviour.
Maturity and usefulness require explicit evaluation criteria.
Every published assessment discloses its supporting evidence and limitations.

categories.AI_INTEGRATION: SAP AI integration service or tooling
categories.DISCOVERY: Public SAP developer discovery and documentation service

assessment_method: R8 rule set: each dimension takes the highest level supported by a verified receipt of the matching evidence class (system readback > local execution > public documentation retrieval); official references support at most DOCUMENTATION_ONLY; no evidence gives NOT_ASSESSED; usefulness and adoption need a recorded owner judgment.

capabilities.name: SAP Developer Center GraphQL
capabilities.official_description: Public GraphQL API over the SAP Developer Center catalogue.
capabilities.engineering_purpose: Machine-readable discovery of what SAP publishes for developers, with source URLs and snapshot dates.
supported_scenarios: Change tracking of published developer content
capabilities.access_requirements: Public, no API key
capabilities.next_hands_on_action: Record a sealed discovery snapshot and compare two snapshots for changes.
improvement_opportunities: Tie each catalog entry to a dated snapshot of its source

capabilities.name: SAP Developers public MCP (Search and Knowledge Graph)
capabilities.official_description: Hosted, anonymous MCP servers for tutorials, missions and a concept graph.
capabilities.engineering_purpose: Ground AI-assisted design questions in SAP-published material instead of model memory.
supported_scenarios: Source-cited answers to SAP developer questions
Finding tutorials and concepts for a design task
capabilities.access_requirements: Anonymous read tier
capabilities.next_hands_on_action: Repeat the investigation with the same question to obtain a comparable second run.
improvement_opportunities: Filter low-signal event pages from results

capabilities.name: SAP Developer CLI (sap-devs) and local MCP
capabilities.official_description: Open-source command-line access to SAP developer content with a local MCP mode.
